domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with regrouping, representation changes, and simplification

skills.name: Align fraction forms
skills.definition: Rewrite quantities into a directly subtractable form before subtraction by matching denominators, normalizing mixed numbers with improper fractional parts, or rewriting a whole number as a mixed form with a zero fractional part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution finds a common denominator and rewrites one or both fractions as equivalent fractions.
Tag when the solution normalizes a mixed number with an improper fractional part, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2, before subtraction.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as n + 0/d so its fractional part can be subtracted in a mixed-number setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators already match and no rewriting is performed.
Do not tag borrowing 1 whole during subtraction after an insufficient or negative fractional part appears; that is regrouping during subtraction.
Do not tag the actual subtraction computation or final simplification.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out subtraction once forms are compatible by subtracting numerators of like fractions and/or subtracting whole-number and fractional parts separately.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution subtracts fractions with the same denominator by subtracting numerators.
Tag when the solution subtracts whole parts and fractional parts separately in a mixed-number, whole-number, or fraction context.
Tag when the subtraction step produces an intermediate negative fractional part before any borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create compatible forms, such as common denominators, normalization, or rewriting a whole as 0/d.
Do not tag borrowing or decomposition steps used to fix an insufficient fractional part.
Do not tag simplification-only or final-expression steps.

skills.name: Regroup for subtraction
skills.definition: Borrow 1 whole from the whole-number part and convert it into denominator-sized fractional units so subtraction can continue when the fractional part is insufficient.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solution borrows 1 from the whole part after a negative or insufficient fractional difference appears.
Tag when the borrowed whole is converted into d/d and added to the existing fractional part.
Tag when regrouping is used in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction to complete the computation.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag initial rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d; that belongs to aligning fraction forms.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag ordinary subtraction steps that do not involve borrowing, or final simplification/combining steps.

skills.name: Simplify and express
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as a fraction, mixed number, whole number, or zero.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced to lowest terms, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when a zero fraction such as 0/3 or 0/8 is expressed as 0 or absorbed into a whole-number result.
Tag when separate whole and fractional results are combined into the final mixed number, integer, fraction, or zero answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction computation itself.
Do not tag denominator matching, normalization, rewriting a whole as 0/d, or borrowing steps.
Do not tag intermediate unsimplified forms unless the step explicitly simplifies or states the final expressed result.
